style.copy: Warm, emotive and story-led. Three to five short lines with line breaks and a few relevant emoji. End with a soft call to action (visit, save the post, tag a friend). Eight to fifteen hashtags mixing broad and niche tags.
style.visual: Vertical lifestyle photo with one clear subject (a person or a product) framed close and off-centre, warm natural light, rich festive colours, shallow depth of field.

style.copy: Professional and insight-led. Open with a hook, tell the business or community story in two or three short paragraphs, no more than one emoji. End with a professional call to action (visit, connect, learn more). Three to five hashtags.
style.visual: Wide professional scene: a team, workspace or craft in action, clean composition, natural light, credible and polished.

style.copy: Punchy and conversational. One or two short sentences with a clear hook and a direct call to action. At most one emoji. One or two hashtags.
style.visual: Wide cinematic banner: bold, high-contrast scene with one strong focal point that still reads at small size.
